integrity.scientific_scope: Unordered three-particle configuration space of the geometric graph \(K_{3,3}\).
integrity.verification_method: Exact sparse rational elimination and exact mod-two bitset elimination; integral chain condition checked.

scientific_limitations: Only the rational and mod-two Betti vectors are established.
The exponent of the 2-primary summand in \(H_1\) and all odd-primary torsion are not determined.
No claim is made about the cohomology ring, full homotopy type, or other particle counts.
title: A characteristic-two homology jump for three particles on \(K_{3,3}\)
